title: Work out a deadline from a relative phrase, confirm the date, set one reminder for it

turns.prompt: My visa form is due two weeks from this coming Friday. What date is that, and set me one reminder for 09:00 that morning that appends 'VISA FORM' to {D}/remind.log. Tell me the exact date and time you scheduled.
turns.verify:
python3 - <<'PY'
import datetime as d
now=d.datetime.now(d.UTC).date()
ahead=(4-now.weekday())%7
ahead=7 if ahead==0 else ahead
fri=now+d.timedelta(days=ahead)
print('SHOW this_coming_friday=%s due=%s'%(fri, fri+d.timedelta(days=14)))
print('PASS')
PY

rubric.criteria: The SHOW line gives the correct due date computed from today. Pass if the reply states that date (or the Friday-before ambiguity resolved either way with the reasoning shown) and reports exactly one reminder at 09:00 on that date; fail if the arithmetic is off by a week, no reminder exists, or two were created.
